example.title: Mill Creek Bridge (Delaware Bridge No. 9A), State Route 6 over Mill Creek

brief: Low multi-span state-highway trestle bridge of 1936 across a wide, flat tidal creek: a reinforced-concrete deck and curbs carried on timber pile bents with cross-bracing and squared timber caps, with a concrete post-and-double-rail railing (square posts with capped tops, two rectangular rails) along both sides and W-beam guardrail on the approaches. Two-lane rural highway through flat farmland and marsh. HAER record is photographs and field notes only (no dimensions); deck height about 8 ft above the water, spans about 15 ft (estimated from photos).

traits.railing_detail: concrete posts with two concrete rails
